Subject: Adjunct observability SKU pricing — proposal and next steps

Jordan / Samir —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a compact proposal that separates the three add-ons you asked about: retention tiers, tracing (span ingestion), and advanced dashboards. Key things we tried to surface:

- Seatless vs seat-based dashboard pricing options (small/medium/large projects)
- Retention buckets (30 / 90 / 365 days) with incremental per-GB amortization
- Tracing ingestion (spans per minute) and a smoothing credit for predictable volumes
- Pilot credits: one month of 30-day retention on small tier + 2 weeks free tracing ingestion for PoC

Can you confirm: (1) the expected Q3 ingestion / host counts in the attached workbook, and (2) whether procurement prefers a consolidated invoice or line-item billing for add-ons? If you’re good, Ben will follow up with a suggested discount path for a 12-month commitment.

Attachments: 20250505-addons-pricing-proposal.pdf; bluepeak-usage-estimates.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks Sofia — quick clarifying questions before we run numbers with Finance:

1) For the seatless advanced dashboards option, what happens if we exceed the included dashboard panels — is overage purely metered or is there a soft cap?
2) The retention buckets look sensible; can you confirm archival egress costs if we request a bulk export at year-end?
3) For tracing: does the smoothing credit apply across all services or only to spans tagged as "priority"?

Procurement (ProcureOps) is looped in on billing cadence — they generally prefer a single consolidated invoice but will accept line-item if it helps with budget allocation.

Can Ben propose a simple discount ladder tied to committed monthly spend? A quick mutual-action-plan would help us present to Legal.

—Jordan

Subject: Re: Adjunct observability SKU pricing — proposal and next steps

Jordan — appreciate the questions. Short answers up front, then a suggested discount ladder below.

- Seatless dashboards: We meter panels beyond the included threshold. For the PoC/initial 90 days we can set a soft cap + overage alerting; routing to a higher tier is manual unless you want auto-upgrade.
- Archival egress: standard egress (per-GB) applies; we can provide a one-time bulk-export credit for annual compliance exports as part of a committed plan.
- Tracing smoothing credit: applies to total spans; we can carve out a "priority" tag if you want separate accounting, but smoothing is easier to model at aggregate level.

Proposed discount ladder for a 12-month consolidated commitment (applies if you choose consolidated invoice):
- $50k–$100k monthly commit: 10% off list add-on unit rates + one pilot month free of 30-day retention (small tier)
- $100k–$250k monthly: 18% off + two pilot months + one-time archival export credit
- >$250k monthly: 25% off + bespoke SLA / accelerated support onboarding credits

If you prefer seat-based dashboards we can convert the seatless credits into per-seat discounts (rough parity for the sizes you shared). I’ll draft a short MAP and attach an updated pricing PDF tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (650) 555-0199

Hi Ben / Sofia —

A couple of procurement items we need to resolve before Legal can proceed:

- Invoicing: BluePeak prefers net-45 consolidated invoices. Is Net-45 acceptable?
- PO language: we need a clause that details add-on overage caps and a notification period (30 days) before billing overages.
- SOW: please provide a short SOW for the dashboard onboarding and tracing ramp (deliverables + acceptance criteria).

Also, can you confirm whether the pilot credits will be applied as an invoice credit or as an account-level promotional allowance? Our finance team leans toward invoice credits.

Thanks — we can expedite if we have a short MAP and the SOW by EOD Friday.

—ProcureOps (BluePeak Finance & Procurement)

All —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary / agreed next steps below:

1) Commercial: Redwood will offer the 18% discount tier on a 12-month consolidated commit ("middle" ladder) subject to signed SOW + Net-45 consolidated invoicing. Pilot credits will be applied as an invoice credit on the first billing cycle.
2) Technical: seatless dashboards will be metered; we’ll include a soft cap and automated alerts for the PoC period. Tracing smoothing will apply to aggregate spans; we’ll add a tag carve-out if BluePeak needs separate reporting.
3) Procurement asks: Ben will attach a 1-page SOW (deliverables + acceptance criteria) and a revised pricing PDF with overage notification language by EOD Monday. I’ve also updated the proposal workbook to reflect the commit assumptions.
4) Signatures & next steps: I’m including the DocuSign link in the HubSpot record (see related links). Once Legal confirms, we’ll route for signature and schedule onboarding for the week after signature.

Deliverables assigned: Ben (pricing PDF + SOW), Sofia (MAP + DocuSign prep), Karthik (technical scope for tracing).

If that aligns, I’ll schedule a 30-minute handoff with your Legal/Procurement on Tuesday.

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
